glossary.meaning: Glucose 3 hours after a meal's bolus less the reading at the bolus, in mg/dL, for a meal no later meal began within those 3 hours.
The insulin the pump delivered steadily through the day, including Control-IQ's changes to the programmed rate.
A matured change's result against its before period.
A Trial or a Focus. One is active at a time.
How far glucose rose after a meal: its highest reading in the 3 hours after the bolus, before any next meal, less the reading at the bolus, in mg/dL.
The pump's automatic boluses, as the day's insulin counts them.
A bolus you gave to bring glucose down, or the correction part of a meal bolus.
Duration of insulin action: how long the pump counts a bolus as still working, in hours.
Mark a Setting's change as programmed into the pump. The next sync checks it.
Stop watching the active change.
A Pattern's habit, or a Habit, you chose to watch for adherence and outcome.
Glucose by time of day over the selected window (14, 30 or 90 days): the median and the 10th–90th percentile spread.
Something you do that the engine counts toward a glucose outcome, queued on its own when no Pattern holds it, such as a meal with no bolus.
Insulin-to-carb ratio, the pump's carb ratio: the grams of carbs one unit of insulin covers.
The standard CGM metrics. Below 54 and Above 250 are shown as subsets of Below 70 and Above 180, never as separate bands of the same total.
glossary.term: In range, Below 70, Below 54, Above 180, Above 250, Mean, GMI, CV

glossary.meaning: Everything the pump delivered in a day, basal and boluses together, in units (U).
Insulin sensitivity factor, the pump's correction factor: how far one unit of insulin lowers glucose, in mg/dL.
Record carbs eaten without a bolus.
A change still collecting its 14 days of after data.
A bolus for carbs, or the carbs part of a bolus.
A meal's carbs in grams: under 25, 25–39, 40–59 or 60 and over. Meal size counts the selected window's meals that began at or under 180 mg/dL with glucose flat before the bolus.
The middle value: of the profile at that time of day, or of a meal size's meals.
The sync after a Done found the Setting unchanged on the pump.
A recurring glucose outcome the engine detected, such as highs after meals.
The highest or lowest glucose after an event such as a meal, as the median across the events counted, in mg/dL.
Minutes from a meal's bolus to the reading its Climb is read from.
The active pump settings, read-only.
The ranked list of recommendations.
The engine's interval for a Setting's estimate.
An answer or entry was saved.
Bring a snoozed item back.
Glucose above 250 mg/dL with no meal bolus in the 2.5 hours before it and no low or Suspend it climbed from: carbs the pump may not have been told about.
A new infusion site and cartridge, as the pump logged it.
The pump's sleep schedule, when Control-IQ runs its tighter overnight target.
Remove from the Queue for 14 days. It returns early if the evidence changes.
A stretch when the pump delivered no basal, whether Control-IQ or you stopped it.
The vendor account the data syncs from.
A pump setting change the app detected, watched against its before period.
The same for the comparison events: similar events that did not end in the Pattern's or the Habit's outcome.
Not yet clear enough to act on: the evidence behind it is thin.
Reverse the last snooze or Done.
Done, and no sync has shown the pump since.
The answers to whether carbs were eaten for a low or a rise. False low marks a low's reading itself as invalid; a rise has none.
glossary.term: Yes / No / False low / Not sure
